newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiki Co, Ishikawajima Transport to list on TSE.
newsitem.headline: Daiki Co, Ishikawajima Transport to list on TSE.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange(TSE) said Tuesday that Daiki Co Ltd and Ishikawajima Transport Co Ltd plan to list on the first and second sections of the exchange respectively.

Daiki, a retailer of household and do-it-yourself goods as well as a manufacturer of purification equipment for industrial waste water, will list on November 15, the TSE said. It is currently listed on the Osaka Securities Exchange.
Crane and conveyor belt manufacturer Ishikawajima, a subsidiary of Ishikawajima-Harima Heavy Industries Co Ltd, will list on November 28.
